install_rule: Select the correct official v0.13.0 asset for the new Mac architecture; verify that asset against the official release checksum. These previous arm64 hashes do not validate an Intel asset.
keyring_rule: Reauthorize on the new Mac; explicitly verify auth status storage=keyring. The retained v0.13.0 review observed plaintext fallback when keyring probing fails; do not proceed with plaintext/file credential storage. Never export the old Keychain token.
new_mac_env_rule: Resolve XDG_CONFIG_HOME=<NEW_ROOT>/work/private-connections/config and XDG_CACHE_HOME=<NEW_ROOT>/work/private-connections/cache as absolute paths; these directories and their content are not included.
